name: On-Prem Git & SVN for Jira Cloud
summary: Commits, branches and merge requests from self-managed GitLab, and revisions from Subversion, in the Jira Cloud Development panel.
points: Nothing to open in your firewall: your servers push the events
Runs on Atlassian: no servers of ours, data stays in Atlassian's cloud
Missing pushes and SVN revisions are detected, never lost silently

include: a screenshot of the app page in Jira (Settings > Apps > On-Prem Git & SVN), including Needs attention if it shows anything;
for GitLab: the response shown in the system hook's Recent events;
for Subversion: the output of the status command of the connector hook.

name: Ops Essentials for Jira Service Management
summary: Heartbeat monitoring, operations reports, stakeholder updates and a long-term alert archive for Jira Service Management.
points: Heartbeats: an alert opens when a backup, job or integration stops checking in
Reports: time to acknowledge and resolve, after-hours load, noisiest alerts
Stakeholder updates to Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat or e-mail
30-day free trial on the Atlassian Marketplace

include: a screenshot of the Overview tab of the app (Settings > Apps > Ops Essentials);
for heartbeats: the name of the heartbeat and the time of its last call;
for stakeholder updates: the result shown in Recent updates.
